items.title: Shelly Berg interviewed by Monk Rowe, Scottsdale, Arizona, April 15, 2000
items.q: I think that’s certainly speaks to the appeal of Diana Krall and some of — you know she sold over a million CDs.

ctx.x: You don’t see too much jazz in the video format on T.V. I suppose that would help too. In a sense I wish it wasn’t necessary because I think jazz is enough for your imagination. But I suppose you have to do whatever you can.

Yeah you have to play the hand that’s dealt. And you can’t ignore the habits of a generation. You can’t turn a blind eye to the way that they’re going to receive and are receiving their entertainment. So there has to be a changeover into that. We must have jazz videos, and I think BET is trying to accomplish that in some way with their Bet On Jazz channel. So pieces are there. There’s an infrastructure that’s in place it just remains to be seen what’s going to be done with it. It’s improving, I can feel that. I…
there’s some demographic now that’s significant and is accepting this as a part of their lifestyle.
